items.text: Patriots will likely activate WR AJ Brown off IR to play vs Jets Sunday; practiced limited all week after high-ankle sprain. Listed Q but anticipated return.
items.why: High-ankle; limited practice all week, earlier than expected.
items.implication: Major boost to NE passing; startable if active.
items.opportunity: Immediate WR1/2 upside in return; monitor snap share vs Henderson status.
items.conflict: Levitan notes still unclear as of Fri night Q tag.

items.text: Eagles not planning to place QB Jalen Hurts on IR; remains sidelined indefinitely with superficial blood clot in calf. First game without him Sunday; Tanner McKee starts.
items.why: Superficial blood clot; info gathering continues.
items.implication: McKee starts behind makeshift line; top pass-catchers healthy.
items.opportunity: Elevated targets/routes for DeVonta Smith, Goedert, Wicks, others with no Hurts dual-threat.

items.text: Ravens will play another game without Lamar Jackson (ankle); Tyler Huntley starts again vs Browns.
items.implication: Downgrade to Ravens pass game; Flowers still viable WR2, Andrews more benchable.
items.opportunity: Huntley checkdowns could boost Andrews/Likely slightly but overall lower ceiling.

items.text: Eagles ruled out RB Saquon Barkley for Sunday vs Panthers (hamstring); second straight miss. Will Shipley also OUT.
items.implication: Eagles RB room thin with Shipley also out; Tanner McKee at QB.
items.opportunity: Increased role for remaining backs (e.g. Dameon Pierce) and pass-catchers in vacuum.

items.text: Unclear on Qs AJ Brown (ankle), TreVeyon Henderson (ankle), DJ Moore (shoulder). Tyler Warren (groin) Friday Q add. Probable lean: Caleb Williams, DK Metcalf (illness), Chris Olave (illness), Rico Dowdle. PIT thin at WR (no Pittman/Wilson/Skowronek) so heavy 2-WR Metcalf + Bernard. PHI McKee has top-4 pass-catchers healthy (DeVonta/Goedert/Wicks/Lemon) but 4th-string RB Pierce.
items.why: Practice reports + Friday additions; PIT depth chart; PHI personnel.
items.implication: Fade unclear ankles if limited; lean start probables; Metcalf volume spike; PHI pass-catchers viable with McKee.
items.opportunity: Metcalf target share in 2-WR; PHI WRs/TE routes with no Saquon/Hurts dual threat.
items.conflict: AJ Brown Rapoport lean active vs Levitan unclear.

items.text: Breece Hall OUT (quad) along with AD Mitchell; Jets RB/WR depth hit.
items.opportunity: Full backfield opportunity for remaining Jets RBs.

items.text: Rashee Rice OUT (hamstring) vs Chargers; Tyquan Thornton also OUT.
items.implication: KC WR targets open; Worthy/others elevated.
items.opportunity: Increased routes/targets for Xavier Worthy and KC pass-catchers.

items.text: DeVonta Smith IN (cleared, removed from report) despite earlier hamstring/toe issues; will play with McKee.
items.implication: Borderline WR2 with Hurts out but volume opportunity.
items.opportunity: Primary target in McKee offense; routes/targets up without Saquon.

items.text: IN/cleared: Ladd McConkey, Quentin Johnston, CeeDee Lamb, Ashton Jeanty, Michael Penix, Marvin Harrison Jr. (noted Texans?); multiple others full go.
items.implication: Full workloads expected; start with confidence.
items.opportunity: Restored snap/route shares for these skill players.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson diagnosed high-ankle sprain; surprised he practiced. NE plays TNF next week so this week's practice may be more for Week 7 availability. Listed Q.
items.why: High-ankle; practiced but GTD risk, especially with short week ahead.
items.implication: Risky start; Rhamondre elevated if out.
items.opportunity: If OUT, full Rhamondre work; if IN limited, still committee.

items.text: Packers RB Josh Jacobs removed from Commissioner Exempt list Monday; eligible to practice/play Week 7. Investigation remains open.
items.why: NFL decision; probe ongoing but can return.
items.implication: ROS boost; stash if dropped; GB RB situation clarifies next week.

items.text: LOVE Mike Evans vs WSH (WR4 ranking); Commanders secondary buffet for pass-catchers.
items.why: Elite matchup vs WSH defense allowing big WR production; strong usage.
items.opportunity: High target share expected in favorable spot.

items.text: LOVE Drake London vs CHI (WR6) for bankable usage; LOVE Kyren Williams vs ARI (RB5) for elite recent usage + leaky run D; also Javonte Williams @GB (RB8 goal-line) and Rhamondre vs NYJ (RB9 volume).
items.why: London usage reliable; Kyren volume elite vs soft run D; Javonte GL work; Rhamondre volume vs Jets.
items.implication: Strong RB/WR starts in good spots.
items.opportunity: Snap/route/carry shares favor these in positive game scripts/matchups.

items.text: HATE Jaylen Waddle vs SEA (WR28 ugly matchup); HATE Emeka Egbuka vs PIT (WR34 shaky QB/feed); also Kyle Pitts vs CHI (TE18), JK Dobbins vs SEA, Bo Nix vs SEA, Justin Herbert @KC.
items.why: Tough pass Ds (SEA), low feed/QB issues, poor team totals.
items.opportunity: Low expected targets/carries vs stout defenses or low-scoring envs.
